name: ai4science-skills
description: Community index of Claude skills for scientific work. Every entry is pinned to an exact commit and checked automatically.

plugins.name: szl-evidence-skills
plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev as an optional, fail-closed second reader for evidence triage; decisions that carry their own evidence. Same source revision as the science pack.
hosted_services: api.typesafe.ai - szl-typesafe-ai only, optional; sends the state you pass it; requires your own TypeSafe key
docs.typesafe.ai - linked documentation; visiting fetches documentation, not benchmark input
console.typesafe.ai - linked credential console; user-controlled credential setup

plugins.name: szl-science-skills
plugins.description: Twenty-three offline, stdlib-only science checks: project workbench and claim ledger, dataset leakage, model evaluation with complete denominators, math and kernel checks, paired qualification, reproducibility capsules, artifact lineage, unit invariants, negative controls, analysis-plan audit, evidence gate, cross-implementation check, mutation coverage, energy receipts, session receipts and a one-page reviewer pack.
hosted_services: huggingface.co - optional explicit fetch-triage downloads four pinned public synthetic-study files and records byte hashes; public artifact CDN redirects may occur; no credentials or private data sent. Normal init/run/check is offline.
example.invalid - reserved example hostname inside a refutation-ledger fixture (a receipt URL); never contacted

fixtures.claim: SKILL.md: the example returns ABSTAIN (PASS 2, FAIL 1, ABSTAIN 1)
SKILL.md: 12/100 vs 25/100 with 7 lost to follow-up has fragility index 2 and is FRAGILE
SKILL.md: the five-query example scores (nDCG@5 0.5144) with q5-never-run kept at zero
SKILL.md: the flipped row p05 makes the example DEGRADED
SKILL.md: B is NOT_REPLICATED and C rests on it, so both are shaken
SKILL.md: the example chain verifies VALID

plugins.name: k-dense-scientific-rigor
plugins.description: Three study-design and evidence-appraisal skills from K-Dense's claude-scientific-skills, selected because they complement the executable SZL checks: design before data (randomization, blocking, factorial layouts), a priori power and sample size, and structured critical appraisal (biases, confounders, GRADE and Cochrane tools). Advisory, prompt-and-script guidance; indexed at a pinned upstream tag and maintained upstream by K-Dense.
